entries.title: Psalms 20:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The church blesses the king in his exploits; 7 and expresses her confidence in God's succour.

A.M. 2968. B.C. 1036. hear. 41:1; 46:1; 50:5; 60:11; 91:15; 138:7; Jer 30:7; Mt 26:38,39; Heb 5:7 name. 9:10; 83:18; Ex 34:5-7; Pr 18:10; Isa 50:10 God. 46:7,11; Ge 32:27-29; 48:15,16; Ex 3:13-15 defend. Heb. set thee on an high place. 18:2; 91:14; 114:2

entries.title: Psalms 20:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thee help. Heb. thy help. from. 73:17; 1Ki 6:16; 8:44,45; 2Ch 20:8,9 strengthen. Heb. support thee. out. 2Sa 5:7; 6:17; Isa 12:6; 14:32; 37:34,35

entries.title: Psalms 20:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Remember. Ge 4:4; Isa 60:7; Eph 5:2; 1Pe 2:5 accept. Heb. turn to ashes, or, make fat. Le 9:24; 1Ch 21:26; 2Ch 7:1

entries.title: Psalms 20:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Now. 2:2; 18:50; 28:8; 89:20-23; Ac 2:36; 4:10 he will. 1Ki 8:30,43; Mt 6:9 his holy heaven. Heb. the heaven of his holiness. Isa 57:15; 63:15 with, etc. Heb. by the strength of the salvation of hisright hand. 17:7; 18:35; Ac 2:33; 5:31

entries.title: Psalms 20:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Save, etc. or, "O Jehovah, save the king; answer us when wecall upon thee." 118:25,26; Mt 21:9,15 let. 2:6-10; 5:2; 24:7; 44:4; 74:12
